title: Chest pain
licence: NHS website terms / Open Government Licence; paraphrased snapshot

chunks.text: Call 999 for sudden chest pain or discomfort that does not go away, pain spreading to an arm, neck, jaw, stomach or back, or chest pain with sweating, nausea, light-headedness or shortness of breath. These signs may need immediate hospital treatment. Seek medical advice for chest pain that recurs or resolves quickly but still causes concern.
